description: RED Friday: Remember Everyone DeployedRED Friday stands for Remember Everyone Deployed, a tradition that encourages civilians and military families to wear red on Fridays to show support for U.S. service members serving overseas.The movement became popular in the early 2000s during conflicts such as the Iraq War and the War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).
